taskText: Add a GET /todos/stats endpoint that returns a JSON object with two fields: total (the number of todos) and completed (the number of completed todos). Write a Jest test that creates three todos, marks one completed, then asserts the stats endpoint returns { total: 3, completed: 1 }. Run the test suite and confirm it passes.
